metadata.defaultTitle: Tello Printing Center — Professional Printing Equipment
metadata.description: Tello Printing Center is a retail store and supplier of professional printing equipment, including 3D, DTF and UV printers, printing materials, inks, parts and accessories.
metadata.keywords: printing equipment, printing supplies, 3D printers, DTF printers, UV printers, printing materials, printing inks, printer parts, Tello Printing Center
metadata.productsDescription: Browse 3D, DTF and UV printers, industrial printing machines, filaments, inks, parts and accessories from Tello Printing Center.

hero.title: Your trusted supplier for professional printing equipment.
hero.description: Tello Printing Center is a retail store and supplier of professional printing equipment, materials and accessories. Browse machines, compare product options and order the equipment your business needs.
hero.imageAlt: Professional printing equipment displayed for customers

about.title: Tello Printing Center: Your Destination for 3D Printing Solutions and Industrial Equipment in Syria
about.description: Founded in 1985 in the heart of Damascus, on Amin Al-Rihani Street, Tello Library / Tello Printing Center has grown into a leading technology partner and a trusted supplier of office and engineering equipment and services.
about.imageAlt: Digital calipers measuring a precision 3D printed lattice component on a dark workbench

story.title: Four decades of experience, built on precision.

paragraphs.experience: Over 40 years of experience and excellence, we have built a bridge between innovative ideas and practical delivery, placing our deep technical expertise at the service of Syria's engineering community, students and industrial sectors.
paragraphs.choice: Whether you are looking for a professional team to execute your project with exceptional precision, or you want to purchase advanced industrial machinery and equipment for your company, Tello Printing Center is your ideal choice.

services.title: Professional services: printing your ideas with precision
services.description: At Tello, we operate an advanced, fully equipped technology facility built to handle the most demanding engineering requirements and student projects.

printing.title: Custom 3D Printing
printing.description: We transform your CAD and 3D files into precise, tangible architectural and engineering models.

scanning.title: 3D Scanning
scanning.description: Professional digital scanning of physical objects for reverse engineering.

industrial.title: DTF & UV Printing
industrial.description: Direct-to-film thermal printing on woven fabrics (DTF) and high-resolution printing on solid surfaces (UV).

documents.title: Engineering Plotting & Documents
documents.description: Large-format engineering plotting, plus fast, high-precision document scanning and copying.

materials.title: Materials and consumables: everything you need in one place
materials.description: Tello Printing Center stocks a diverse range of raw materials for self-production and custom projects.

filaments.title: 3D Filaments
filaments.description: More than 100 colors across PLA, PETG, TPU and ABS, plus durable carbon fiber filament.

industrial.title: Industrial Materials
industrial.description: Available as standard rolls or plastic pellets to meet the needs of workshops and factories.

consumables.title: Industrial Consumables
consumables.description: Longlu UV ink, DTF inks, PET rolls and thermal TPU powder.

why.title: Why choose Tello Printing Center?
why.description: Because we combine four decades of proven experience with the latest digital manufacturing technologies, bringing high quality and competitive pricing to the Syrian market.

heritage.title: Four decades of experience
heritage.description: Since 1985, we have built deep expertise across office, engineering and industrial equipment and services.

technology.title: Advanced digital manufacturing
technology.description: We work with the latest digital manufacturing technologies to deliver precise, reliable results.

value.title: Quality with competitive pricing
value.description: Our aim is to offer the Syrian market high quality at competitive prices.

categories.title: Seven product areas for professional printing.
categories.description: Machines, materials, inks, parts and accessories — organized so you can find the right product for your operation.
